blocks.text: Neurons follow particular neural pathways (arcs) to receive, transmit and process impulses. Some pathways have only a few neurons; others are complex networks. The reflex arc is the simplest neural pathway; it controls reflex actions, immediate, automatic and involuntary responses to external and internal stimuli.

items: A hammer taps the patellar tendon below the knee; the tap is the stimulus.
A receptor in the quadriceps muscle of the thigh senses it and starts an impulse in a sensory neuron.
The sensory neuron carries the impulse to the spinal cord and passes it to a motor neuron directly, without an inter-neuron.
The motor neuron carries the impulse to the effector, the quadriceps, which contracts: the lower leg kicks forward at the knee.

Meanwhile the sensory neuron also activates an inter-neuron in the spinal cord, which releases chemicals that inhibit the motor neurons of the hamstrings, so the hamstrings relax while the leg extends.

blocks.alt: A thigh with the quadriceps on top and the hamstrings below, the knee and the lower leg hanging down. A hammer taps the patellar tendon below the knee. A blue sensory neuron runs from a receptor in the quadriceps to a cross-section of the spinal cord; a red motor neuron returns to the quadriceps, which contracts so the lower leg kicks forward; a dashed purple inter-neuron path inhibits the hamstrings, which relax.
blocks.caption: Knee-jerk reflex (original diagram after Figure 15.3).
blocks.long_description: Tapping the patellar tendon stretches the quadriceps; a receptor in the muscle starts an impulse in a sensory neuron, which enters the spinal cord and passes it directly to a motor neuron, with no inter-neuron. The motor neuron makes the quadriceps contract and the lower leg kicks forward. At the same time the sensory neuron excites an inter-neuron that inhibits the motor neurons of the hamstrings, so they relax while the leg extends.

blocks.prompt: Why is the knee-jerk reflex so fast?
blocks.explanation: Its arc is very short: the sensory neuron connects directly to the motor neuron in the spinal cord, with no inter-neuron and no need for the brain to decide.

items: Reflex arc: simplest pathway for automatic responses. Knee jerk: receptor in quadriceps, sensory neuron, spinal cord, motor neuron, quadriceps contracts; inter-neuron relaxes hamstrings.
